races.title: Book A Table For New Years Day Mares Handicap Hurdle

races.title: Bill Halley Outstanding Contribution Award 2026 Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: A few with chances but THE DUCKS WALK signalled he is ready to go in again when an excellent runner-up in a big-field handicap at Punchestown recently so gets the vote. Johnny Cakes didn't enjoy the rub of the green when third at Limerick last time and rates a big threat off a handy-looking mark, while El Arco and Talas Kera appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours. races.title: 2027 Group Package Deals Online Beginners Chase
races.verdict: REBEL REBA could only manage second when odds on for a maiden hurdle at Fairyhouse recently but a point win at the start of her career suggests she's worth another chance now chasing. Gavin Cromwell has won this 3 times since 2021 so his Naas handicap hurdle winner Let's Go Mans rates a possible danger. Walk In The Clouds has a profile which suggests she should take to chasing, while Kimy has placed in similar events this autumn. REBEL REBA (IRE) LET'S GO MANS (FR) WALK IN THE CLOUDS (IRE)

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict: This doesn't look the strongest of bumpers, so LADY AURORA makes obvious appeal having joined Willie Mullins after running out an easy winner on her completed start in points. Found It should be capable of building on her opening effort under Rules at Punchestown in early-May, while Shuil Solas bumped into a good prospect on her penultimate outing and merits respect back in calmer waters. LADY AURORA (FR) FOUND IT (IRE) SHUIL SOLAS (IRE)
